tools.name: transpose_chords
tools.description: Transpose a line or chart of chord symbols by a number of semitones, keeping chord qualities and slash bass notes (C/E becomes D/F# up 2). Returns the transposed text with the original spacing and a link to the browser transposer. Works on chord symbols only: not audio, lyrics or notation files.

tools.name: spell_piano_chord
tools.description: List the notes of one chord symbol as piano pitches, lowest first, built up from the root in the chosen octave (a slash bass goes below). Returns each note with its name, octave and MIDI number, plus a link to the browser chord finder. Gives pitches only, not voicings over time or rhythm.

tools.name: tab_to_piano_notes
tools.description: Read six-string ASCII guitar tab in standard tuning and return the sounding pitches as piano notes, in the order they appear.
